summary: Knog is a Richmond (Melbourne) cycling and outdoor accessories design brand founded in 2002, with offices in Melbourne, Europe and the USA and suppliers across South East Asia. Andrew Hedding has been CFO since November 2009 and Virginia Francis Finance Manager since October 2007, a very stable finance team with no visible change trigger.

claims.text: Knog's LinkedIn page gives its headquarters as Richmond, Victoria, with a workforce across Australia and China.
claims.quote: Headquartered in Richmond, Victoria, Australia, with offices in Cremorne and melbourne. Its workforce is distributed across Australia and China.

claims.text: Andrew Hedding's LinkedIn profile lists him as CFO of Knog, current, since November 2009.
Andrew's LinkedIn says Knog works with manufacturers and suppliers across a range of technologies throughout South East Asia.
claims.quote: We work with manufactures and suppliers specialising in a huge range of technologies throughout South East Asia.

claims.text: Andrew's LinkedIn says Knog has offices in Melbourne, Europe and the USA.
claims.quote: With offices in Melbourne, Europe and the USA

claims.text: Knog introduced the Scout Bike Alarm & Finder in 2022 and the Frog, the world's first silicone bike light, in 2008.
claims.quote: in 2022, Knog introduced the Scout Bike Alarm & Finder.

claims.text: Virginia Francis is Finance Manager at Knog, current, since October 2007.
Knog describes a Melbourne-based team of over 20 designers, engineers, marketers, logistics and finance people.
claims.quote: lead a Melbourne (Australia) based team of over 20 designers, engineers, marketers, logistics and finance folk.

hooks.text: Offices in Melbourne, Europe and the USA plus South East Asian suppliers imply multi-currency payables and receivables to reconcile monthly.
Long-tenured CFO and Finance Manager pair running a close for a product range that keeps expanding.

risks.text: Finance team stable for 15+ years with no hiring or change trigger; likely low urgency and entrenched process.
Finance tech stack not found; claims about FX or distributor complexity are inference only.

gaps: No finance job ads, posts by Andrew or Virginia, podcast or recent news found.
Shopify and distributor setup only appears in a third-party tech profile; not used.
Virginia Francis's email is not on file, so Andrew is the only draftable contact.
